environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all traffic to port 8080. Security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application serves directly from the Flask process via Gunicorn.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.medium, ALB with default listener rules (forward all to target group)
config.alb_rules: Single default rule: forward to target group on port 8080
